title: mockRequest
description: Answer matching browser requests with a fixed response, from this step until the test ends. A later `mockRequest` for the same `url` and `method` replaces the earlier one. Runs only in Chrome. In other browsers, the step is skipped.

url.description: Glob for the request URLs to answer. `*` matches any characters. A pattern that starts with `http` matches the whole URL, such as `https://api.example.com/user`. Any other pattern matches the URL's path, such as `**/api/invoices*`.

method.description: HTTP method to answer. Omit to answer every method.

response.description: The response to send. Omit to send an empty `200` response.

statusCode.description: HTTP status code of the response. Omit to send `200`.

headers.description: Response headers, as header names and string values.

body.description: Response body. A string is sent as is. An object or array is sent as JSON. Set `body` or `bodyPath`, not both.

bodyPath.description: File to send as the response body, relative to the spec file. Set `body` or `bodyPath`, not both.
